title: Infant Care Teacher
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 8S/12Q to fewer than 16S/24Q units

program.section_heading: INFANT CARE TEACHER Certificate of Achievement (STATE CODE 15057)
outcomes: Demonstrate a working knowledge of all facets of preschool administration, including legal requirements, staffing issues, fiscal management and parent communication.
Identify, appreciate, and demonstrate respect for inclusive practices and diversity within individuals, families, cultures and communities.
Articulate and demonstrate professional ethics and conduct in all work with agencies, families, and children.
Identify different leadership styles and evaluate their effectiveness in meeting the needs of parents and staff.

blocks.name: Select 3 semester units from the following

notes: The program learning outcomes printed under Infant Care Teacher are identical to those printed for the Preschool Director certificate and focus on preschool administration; they may be a catalog copy error. Recorded as printed.

CH DEV 030 and CH DEV 031 are titled 'Infant and Toddler Studies I' and 'Infant and Toddler Studies II' in this section but 'Infant/Toddler Development' and 'Infant/Toddler Care and Education' elsewhere in the catalog and in the closed list; matched by code.
CH DEV 011 (Child, Family, and Community) is required but absent from the closed list; recorded as a catalog addition.
Catalog prints codes with leading zeros (CH DEV 001); matched to closed-list codes without zeros (CH DEV 1).

Career 'Infant Care Teacher' taken from the program information sentence about State Department of Social Services minimum requirements; the Gainful Employment section refers to an external website for careers.
